short: A heavily armed Swedish warship that foundered on her maiden voyage due to severe instability.
full:
Ordered by King Gustavus Adolphus as a symbol of Swedish naval power, the Vasa was built between 1626 and 1628. She was designed to be one of the most powerfully armed vessels in the world, carrying sixty-four bronze cannons on two gun decks. However, the heavy upperworks and inadequate ballast gave her a dangerously high centre of gravity.

On 10 August 1628, just minutes into her maiden voyage in Stockholm harbour, a strong gust of wind caught her sails. She heeled over, water flooded in through her open gun ports, and she sank, claiming about thirty lives. The remarkably preserved wreck was salvaged in 1661 and fully raised in 1961.
